headline: Thoughtful gifts,
intro: GiftAura brings flower bouquets, beauty creams and carefully chosen gifts to your door. Order online in a few minutes and pay on delivery or by bank transfer.
story_title: A gift shop built on care
story:
GiftAura was started in Bandarakoswatta, Kurunegala, by Asjadh Mohamed Mafras with a simple idea: choosing a gift should feel as good as receiving one.

Today GiftAura is also online, so customers can browse our bouquets, beauty creams and gift items from home, place an order in a few clicks and follow it until it arrives.

Every order is checked and packed with care before it leaves us, because behind every gift is someone who wants to make another person smile.
founder_quote: A gift says what words sometimes cannot. Our job is to help you say it beautifully.
mission: To make thoughtful gifting simple for everyone: beautiful products, clear prices in rupees, and an order you can follow from our shop to your door.
vision: To be the gift shop that people in Kurunegala and across Sri Lanka think of first for every birthday, celebration and thank-you.
